title: Build a Validated field
prompt:
Implement a data descriptor `Validated(min_value, max_value)` usable as a class attribute:

- stores the value under a mangled name chosen in `__set_name__`
- `__set__` raises `ValueError` when the value is not an `int` or is outside `[min_value, max_value]`
- `__get__` on the class (obj is None) returns the descriptor itself
- the class access must expose the declared bounds: `Model.age.min_value == 0`

tests.name: rejects out-of-range and wrong types
tests.hint: Validate type first (must be int — bool is not allowed here, treat non-int as ValueError), then range.

tests.name: descriptor visible on the class with bounds
tests.code:
assert isinstance(Model.age, Validated), 'class access must return the descriptor'
assert Model.age.min_value == 0 and Model.age.max_value == 150
print('ok')
tests.hint: When obj is None, return self.
